messages:
marta: FYI PR #4892 has inconsistent API examples on /v1/generate. Raw examples show camelCase and the streaming response example omits message.content which breaks SSE parsers.
ishan: Confirming policy 1raw API examples should use snake_case (max_new_tokens). SDK snippets remain camelCase.
prashant: I'll patch openapi/generated.yml to update the example response to include a realistic content array and open a tiny follow-up PR for the generated examples.
olivia: Taking the language snippets (JS/curl/python). Will switch raw JSON to snake_case and add an SSE parsing note showing message.content array.
ryan: I'll add a docs unit test that validates OpenAPI examples against the response schema so this doesn't slip again.
doc-bot: CI: docs-lint passed, preview built for branch fix-4892 -> https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/4892
marta: Thanks all. I'll add a changelog line clarifying API vs SDK param naming and the streaming response shape, then close the thread.
